description: The correlated noise source from the Surge mixer, as a single generator.

params.text: Sets the colour of the noise: negative values feed each sample back with the same sign and darken it, positive values feed it back inverted and brighten it, -100% to 100%.

inputs.text: Adds to the Correlation knob, 20 percentage points per volt.

notes: this module is deprecated and hidden in the module browser; the Surge XT plugin replaces it, and both plugins can be used in one patch.
menu: Skins — a submenu of four colour schemes, listed by file name as Classic.xml, Miami.xml, NewYork.xml and Night.xml; picking one repaints every Surge module in the rack.
